title: LUX-ZEPLIN’s anomalous high-energy event
dek: One high-energy interaction survived LZ’s known-background model. The useful story is whether more data and a detailed analysis make it accumulate, acquire a mundane explanation, or disappear.
whyTracked: The anomaly has a persistent experimental identity, a promised detailed paper, accumulating exposure, and a clear path to confirmation, revision, a background explanation, or disappearance.

current.assessment: LZ has reported one 2.6-sigma high-energy event that its known-background model does not readily explain, while explicitly declining to claim dark matter. The detailed analysis was still described as forthcoming during the September 6 admission review.
current.nextReviewTrigger: Review immediately for the promised arXiv paper, journal publication or revision, a detector-background explanation, additional LZ exposure, or an independent experiment testing compatible interactions.

openQuestions: Will the anomaly retain or gain significance when LZ analyzes additional data?
Will the detailed paper identify plausible detector backgrounds or analysis choices not described in the announcement?
Can another direct-detection experiment test the heavier or nonstandard WIMP interactions compatible with the event?

watchFor.trigger: The collaboration releases the promised arXiv paper, submits or publishes the analysis, or issues a revision.
LZ reports whether new data produce compatible events or reduce the anomaly’s significance.
Another dark-matter detector reports a test of the same interaction or parameter region.

observations.headline: Point-zero observation
observations.summary: The LUX-ZEPLIN collaboration reported one high-energy interaction in 220 live days that its known-background model does not readily explain, with a local significance of 2.6 sigma; the collaboration did not claim a dark-matter discovery.

observations.headline: Admitted to The Wake
observations.summary: Admitted because this is precisely the kind of provisional anomaly a longitudinal record can handle without upgrading statistical surprise into a discovery claim.
